claim: The latest SolCentro export still lacks five elements required to complete ingestion.
evidence: Missing fields are a stable installation identifier, the time zone declared by the device, a reading-quality code, contracted nominal power, and a flag distinguishing a meter reset from physical replacement.

claim: The current identifier changes when equipment is reinstalled, so it cannot serve as a historical key.
The time zone can be inferred from the sample but must be delivered explicitly to prevent errors during daylight-saving transitions.
The quality code is required to distinguish measured, estimated, and corrected values.
Contracted power will allow outliers to be detected without applying one threshold to every installation.
